acceptanceNotes.asRunVerdict: The 120-minute run AS MEASURED does not pass: frame-time tier 30 fps fallback (60 fps tier missed), readback criterion not demonstrated, and run integrity failed on 43 uncaught audio scheduling errors.
blockingArtworkDefects: 43 uncaught NotSupportedError exceptions from the live audio graph (bloom envelope scheduling) — the only defect that reproduces in every configuration
instrumentAttributableShortfalls: the 60 fps tier (p95 ≤ 22 ms) was missed only under the unpaced acceptance harness; both controls meet it (p95 16.7 / 16.8 ms)
the readback probe was clipped by its own 300 ms timeout in the 2-hour run; the paced 2000 ms-timeout control measures p95 242 ms (inside the criterion)
outstandingActions: Re-run the 120-minute acceptance once with the fixed pacing to certify the 60 fps tier and the readback criterion at full length.
Fix the live-audio scheduling overlap (src/audio/audio.ts spawnEvent) and re-soak.
Characterise the readback latency tail (a ~1 s sample was observed) — resolve or bound it.

anomalies: the trailing frame-time window is partial (shorter than 5 minutes) and was excluded from the verdict
32 readback probes returned no sample (analyzer busy or timed out)
the app reported 'overload' in 2 post-warmup cadence sample(s)
43 uncaught AudioParam scheduling error(s) on the live audio path (setTargetAtTime overlaps setValueCurveAtTime) — see verdict.runIntegrity.pageErrorSamples
